title: Finikovskiy-pack
description: This resource pack add a lot of features
body:
In this texture pack you can see a LOT of changes. 

### New models

3d and animated torch
![Torch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9638b4da68c2fe58c21ea7bdf7a8c7352bdf74c.png)

Swords In hand (edited only iron-netherite swords)
![Iron and diamond swords in hands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/add29b1c5647f246025e5979c79c5a32f1af0461_0.webp)

Mace now is... hammer!
![Hammer in hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb56c0e4ce151d0e7b39d2be9ab7798ee649cd53_0.webp)

3d book
![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2100d10b9562f409ea752a7d6888f3e469a8186_0.webp)

2d planks in inventory
![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/290b12d28dc6c47481f4ebaa9b77672558afc702_0.webp)

### Textures

Edited hotbar
![Edited hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/030dd8180c8c0b1bc4f0fd868b48361948ca7e29.png)

Wooden sword now is wooden bat
![wooden bat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/362decdbde3863ac8a310c374384a9c814400fef.png)

Hearts flipped
![Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/030dd8180c8c0b1bc4f0fd868b48361948ca7e29.png)

I didn't work well on this texture pack, but in any case, if you're not Finikovsky, then don't download it.
